meta.description: Pilot triage dataset v2 — 20 cases, split thành dev (12) và test (8). Bổ sung 8 hard cases để phân biệt Baseline 3 (Naive LLM) vs Baseline 4 (W3GoAudit Checklist). Hard cases là những tình huống Naive LLM dễ sai vì thiếu reasoning về ngữ cảnh cross-contract, modifier kế thừa phức tạp, và design intent.

labels.TP: True Positive — lỗi thật, đã xác nhận bởi audit report hoặc EVM test
labels.FP: False Positive — cảnh báo sai, đã có guard hoặc không thỏa sufficient condition
labels.Uncertain: Không đủ context để quyết định (thiếu caller/modifier/state)

split.dev: pilot-uint128-tp-001 đến pilot-access-uncertain-002 (12 cases gốc từ v1)
split.test: pilot-hard-* (8 hard cases mới — KHÔNG dùng để tune prompt/rule)

meta.why_hard_cases: Baseline 3 (Naive LLM zero-shot) đạt F1=100% trên v1 12 cases — tập quá dễ. Hard cases thiết kế để Naive LLM sai trong khi Baseline 4 W3GoAudit đúng hoặc đúng hơn. Đây là điều kiện cần để chứng minh đóng góp của knowledge-grounded checklist.

dev_cases.ground_truth_reason: Hàm record() cast uint256 → uint128 trực tiếp không có guard. Khi amount = 2^128 sẽ bị truncate thành 0, vi phạm invariant 'reserve phải bằng giá trị đầu vào'.
dev_cases.finding_title: UnsafeReserve: Silent overflow when casting large reserve amount
dev_cases.finding_content: The `record(uint256 amount)` function stores user-provided `amount` directly into `reserve` which is of type `uint128`. When `amount` exceeds `2^128 - 1`, the cast silently truncates the high bits, causing `reserve` to store an incorrect value. There is no check before the cast.
dev_cases.context_notes: No modifiers. No callers visible in snippet. Function is public.

dev_cases.ground_truth_reason: Có guard `require(amount <= type(uint128).max)` trước cast. Mọi giá trị vượt ngưỡng sẽ revert, không xảy ra silent overflow.
dev_cases.finding_title: GuardedReserve: Casting with explicit bound check (flagged by rule, actually safe)
dev_cases.finding_content: The `record(uint256 amount)` function casts uint256 to uint128. Static rule flags this as potential narrowing overflow.
dev_cases.context_notes: Guard exists immediately before cast. Function reverts on out-of-range. Rule fires but safe.

dev_cases.ground_truth_reason: Fragment nội bộ không thấy caller. Có thể caller đã guard trước khi gọi hàm này, hoặc không. Không đủ context để kết luận.
dev_cases.finding_title: UnknownFragment: Internal function with uint128 cast, no caller visible
dev_cases.finding_content: An internal function casts uint256 to uint128. Cannot determine if the caller validates the input range before invoking this function.
dev_cases.context_notes: Internal function. No callers shown in snippet. Need to inspect all call sites to determine safety.

dev_cases.ground_truth_reason: Finding được xác nhận bởi Code4rena audit report. virtualBaseTokenReserves và virtualNftReserves là uint128, update bằng uint256 value mà không check overflow.
dev_cases.finding_title: [H-03] Risk of silent overflow in reserves update — Caviar
dev_cases.finding_content: However, these two variables are of type `uint128`, while the values that update them are of type `uint256`. This means that casting to a lower type is necessary, but this casting is performed without first checking that the values being cast can fit into the lower type. As a result, there is a risk of a silent overflow occurring during the casting process.
dev_cases.context_notes: Real finding from Code4rena. No guard before cast. Confirmed High severity.

dev_cases.ground_truth_reason: Contract sử dụng SafeCast library từ OpenZeppelin, hàm toUint128() sẽ revert nếu overflow. Rule phát hiện cast nhưng không nhận ra SafeCast wrapper.
dev_cases.finding_title: SafeCast usage flagged as narrowing — false alarm
dev_cases.finding_content: The contract converts uint256 to uint128 in the reserve update function.
dev_cases.context_notes: SafeCast.toUint128() reverts if value > type(uint128).max. Rule sees cast, not the library safety.

dev_cases.ground_truth_reason: Cần xem protocol invariant: giá trị có thể bao giờ vượt 2^128 không? Nếu token là stablecoin với 6 decimals, max supply << 2^128 thì thực ra safe. Cần thêm thông tin về protocol design.
dev_cases.finding_title: Reserve update with narrowing cast — safety depends on token economics
dev_cases.finding_content: The pool stores reserves as uint128. The update function accepts uint256 input.
dev_cases.context_notes: Safety depends on maximum possible token supply. If token has 6 decimals and max supply 10B, max value is 10^16 << 2^128. Need protocol docs to confirm.

dev_cases.ground_truth_reason: Hàm setFeeRecipient() không có bất kỳ modifier kiểm tra quyền nào. Bất kỳ ai cũng có thể gọi và thay đổi fee recipient.
dev_cases.finding_title: Missing access control on setFeeRecipient — anyone can call
dev_cases.finding_content: The `setFeeRecipient` function lacks any access control modifier. Any external address can call it to redirect protocol fees to an arbitrary address.
dev_cases.context_notes: No modifier. No require statement. External visibility. Anyone can call.

dev_cases.ground_truth_reason: Hàm có modifier onlyOwner kế thừa từ Ownable. Rule không parse được inheritance chain, báo nhầm missing access control.
dev_cases.finding_title: onlyOwner through inheritance — flagged but protected
dev_cases.finding_content: The `setFeeRecipient` function appears to have no access control modifier in the function definition.
dev_cases.context_notes: onlyOwner modifier clearly present. Rule might misparse or context might be partial snippet.

dev_cases.ground_truth_reason: Hàm không có modifier tường minh nhưng contract có custom access control có thể check ở constructor hoặc storage mapping. Cần xem toàn bộ contract.
dev_cases.finding_title: Setter with no visible modifier — custom access pattern possible
dev_cases.finding_content: The `updateConfig` function has no access control modifier in its definition.
dev_cases.context_notes: Custom require-based check instead of modifier. Rule expects modifier pattern, misses require-based auth.

dev_cases.ground_truth_reason: Protocol fee setter có thể gọi bởi bất kỳ ai. Attacker có thể redirect fee đến địa chỉ của mình.
dev_cases.finding_title: Protocol fee recipient can be set by any caller
dev_cases.finding_content: The `setProtocolFeeRecipient` function is missing access control, allowing any user to redirect protocol fee revenue to an arbitrary address.
dev_cases.context_notes: No modifier. Emits event. Called externally. Confirmed access control issue.

dev_cases.ground_truth_reason: Hàm intentionally public vì đây là permissionless protocol — bất kỳ ai cũng được phép update theo design. Đây là feature không phải bug.
dev_cases.finding_title: Permissionless update — by design, not a vulnerability
dev_cases.finding_content: The `syncPrice` function can be called by anyone to update the price oracle.
dev_cases.context_notes: Protocol design: permissionless sync is intentional for liveness. Not a vulnerability.

dev_cases.ground_truth_reason: Hàm có timelock nhưng không rõ timelock delay là bao nhiêu. Nếu delay < 24h thì vẫn có rủi ro. Cần xem cấu hình timelock.
dev_cases.finding_title: Admin function behind timelock — safety depends on delay configuration
dev_cases.finding_content: The function is gated behind a timelock contract. The security depends on the timelock delay value.
dev_cases.context_notes: onlyTimelock modifier exists. Need to check if timelock delay is adequate (typically >= 24h for security).

test_cases.ground_truth_reason: SafeCast được gọi qua một hàm wrapper nội bộ _safeToUint128(). Naive LLM thấy `uint128(val)` trực tiếp nhưng không trace được rằng val đã được validate qua wrapper trước khi đến đây. W3GoAudit nên hỏi: 'Có guard nào trên đường đi của giá trị này không?' và trace được qua wrapper.
test_cases.finding_title: Indirect SafeCast via internal wrapper — Naive LLM may flag as TP
test_cases.finding_content: The `_store` function assigns uint128 from a uint256 value. Static analysis flags the cast operation.
test_cases.context_notes: Indirect guard via internal wrapper. Naive LLM sees uint128(raw) in context and may miss the wrapper validation. W3GoAudit checklist Q2 should trigger: 'Is cast protected by SafeCast or explicit require?'

test_cases.ground_truth_reason: Cast nằm trong block `unchecked {}`. Naive LLM có thể nhầm rằng unchecked chỉ là tối ưu gas và không nguy hiểm. Nhưng unchecked không thêm guard — nó loại bỏ overflow check của Solidity 0.8+, làm silent overflow dễ xảy ra hơn. Đây là TP nghiêm trọng hơn case bình thường.
test_cases.finding_title: Unsafe cast inside unchecked block — Naive LLM may misinterpret as safe
test_cases.finding_content: Reserve update performs arithmetic in unchecked context with subsequent uint128 cast.
test_cases.context_notes: Unchecked block disables Solidity 0.8+ overflow revert. Cast still truncates. No require guard. Naive LLM may see 'unchecked' and assume deliberate safe usage.

test_cases.ground_truth_reason: Hàm được bảo vệ bởi multi-sig Gnosis Safe qua modifier onlyMultisig. Naive LLM có thể không nhận ra multi-sig là một dạng access control hợp lệ và báo TP. W3GoAudit checklist Q2 hỏi 'Is there an access control modifier or authorization require?' → answer Yes: onlyMultisig.
test_cases.finding_title: Admin function protected by Gnosis Safe multi-sig — Naive LLM may not recognize pattern
test_cases.finding_content: The `withdrawFunds` function lacks a standard onlyOwner modifier. Static analysis flags it as missing access control.
test_cases.context_notes: onlyMultisig is a valid custom access control modifier backed by Gnosis Safe. Not 'missing' access control — different implementation from standard Ownable. Naive LLM may not recognize custom modifier as equivalent to onlyOwner.

test_cases.ground_truth_reason: Timelock được cấu hình với delay=0 trong constructor, biến onlyTimelock thành vô nghĩa về mặt bảo mật. Naive LLM thấy onlyTimelock modifier → gán FP. W3GoAudit checklist Q4 hỏi 'Does function rely on external checks whose configuration is not in snippet?' → Uncertain. Với context_notes tiết lộ delay=0 → TP.
test_cases.finding_title: onlyTimelock with zero delay — Naive LLM assigns FP, actually TP
test_cases.finding_content: The `setController` function uses onlyTimelock modifier. However, the timelock was deployed with minDelay=0.
test_cases.context_notes: CRITICAL: TimelockController minDelay=0. onlyTimelock modifier exists but provides zero time-delay protection. Any proposer can propose and immediately execute. Effectively unprotected.

test_cases.ground_truth_reason: Contract kế thừa từ AccessControlUpgradeable và dùng hasRole(). Naive LLM có thể thấy `require(hasRole(MANAGER_ROLE, msg.sender))` và kết luận FP. Nhưng không thể kết luận FP vì: (1) không rõ MANAGER_ROLE được grant cho ai trong initializer, (2) contract upgradeable — admin có thể bị thay thế. Cần xem deployment script và grant logs.
test_cases.finding_title: AccessControl with role-based guard — Naive LLM may assign FP, actually Uncertain
test_cases.finding_content: The `configureProtocol` function uses role-based access control. Static analysis flags function as potentially missing standard modifier.
test_cases.context_notes: Need to verify: (1) who holds MANAGER_ROLE in deployment, (2) whether proxy admin can bypass roles by upgrading implementation, (3) whether MANAGER_ROLE was intended to be highly restricted or widely distributed.

test_cases.ground_truth_reason: Cast xảy ra trong inline assembly block bằng lệnh `shl`/`shr`. Naive LLM có thể không parse được assembly hoặc đưa ra kết luận TP/FP vội vã. W3GoAudit nên nhận ra đây là assembly context → checklist Q2 trả lời Unknown → Uncertain vì thiếu khả năng phân tích inline assembly.
test_cases.finding_title: uint128 truncation via inline assembly — Naive LLM likely misclassifies
test_cases.finding_content: The function performs bit manipulation in assembly that may result in uint128 truncation of uint256 values.
test_cases.context_notes: Inline assembly performs manual uint128 masking. Cannot determine caller's guarantees about upper 128 bits. Need to inspect all callers of packReserve to confirm fullReserve is always < 2^128.

test_cases.ground_truth_reason: Hàm `initialize` là initializer của upgradeable proxy pattern — chỉ có thể gọi một lần duy nhất nhờ `initializer` modifier từ OpenZeppelin. Naive LLM thấy hàm external không có onlyOwner → báo TP. W3GoAudit nên nhận ra `initializer` modifier đảm bảo chỉ gọi được một lần — đây là design pattern hợp lệ, không phải missing access control.
test_cases.finding_title: Proxy initializer flagged as missing access control — Naive LLM false positive
test_cases.finding_content: The `initialize` function is public and appears to lack access control modifier.
test_cases.context_notes: OpenZeppelin `initializer` modifier prevents re-initialization. `_disableInitializers()` in constructor prevents direct implementation attacks. This is a standard upgradeable proxy initialization pattern — NOT a missing access control vulnerability.

test_cases.ground_truth_reason: Có require() trước cast nhưng require check giá trị SAI — check `amount < 2^128` thay vì `amount <= type(uint128).max` (= 2^128 - 1). Giá trị 2^128 - 1 vẫn pass require nhưng khi cast sang uint128 thì bị truncate. Naive LLM thấy require → gán FP. W3GoAudit checklist Q2: 'Is require checking amount <= type(uint128).max?' → No (off by one) → TP.
test_cases.finding_title: Off-by-one in require guard — Naive LLM assigns FP, actually TP
test_cases.finding_content: The reserve update function has a require check before casting to uint128. However, the boundary condition is incorrect.
test_cases.context_notes: Off-by-one error: require(amount < 2**128) allows amount = 2**128-1 = type(uint128).max which casts CORRECTLY. Actually this case is subtle — 2^128-1 is MAX value for uint128 so it's fine. But require(amount < 2**128) incorrectly allows amount = 2**128-1... wait, 2**128-1 IS type(uint128).max. The actual TP scenario: if guard was require(amount < type(uint128).max) then 2**128-1 would fail guard but be max valid value. This case: attacker passes amount = 2**128 which fails require. Actually safe. REVISED: This is FP — the guard works correctly.
